items.note: S1.1.1-S1.1.5 follow the proof at 741-765 line by line: scratch cancellation, net map (JV+RG)x, bit and complex coefficients, and the three-stage exchange to (-Y,X). The neighbour and wire counts (767-782) and the constants h=100, N, m are not given, but the lemma itself is fully reconstructed.
The invariant at sources, edges and pointwise gates and the resulting D_out S D_in^{-1} with the route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} match 804-825 exactly.

Labels from triple indicators with <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, the stage transitions, the side-wire inclusion, the single decreasing edge (centre 3->4, loss h), telescoping and L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L all follow 845-1071; ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are as at 1105-1110. The gate-label table (975-988) and residual table (1021-1043) are cited rather than reproduced.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the 2P_{U_a} exception, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b and the endpoint identity I_m on every role match the proof at 1156-1171.

The proposition's conclusions (one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, C^{tensor m} after corrections, Z-repair of the 27 inverse factors) are correct. But the phase frame C_U=H^{tensor m} diag(i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}) H^{tensor m} is never defined, and the core proof step (weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, i^{eps[v.x]}=a+b(-1)^{v.x}, Hadamard conjugation to X_v, lines 1232-1257) is missing.

s_b<W_b m via deficit N-2L_b>0 from L/N<1/2, s_c<W_c m, and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 follow 1105-1110, 1167 and 1331-1344. The numerical values of eta_b, eta_c are not given, only their lower bound.

The plan uses the controlled-shifts lemma (S2.1.2) and row splitting into W streams (S2.2.1) as tools, and relies on 'stream-ops' and 'controlled-shifts', but never states either lemma's content (digit permutations, split/merge, y->y+a(controls) mod q^b with b^{O(1)} offset cost).

Pivot elimination for A=E_1 Pi E_2, lower-triangular transforms in descending order by controlled shifts, the order of transforms, and the three-step realisation of each one of Pi with a single interchange match 1375-1446.

Row split into W role streams, edge shears via matrix-shear, frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, merge undoing rho, three shears to a swap, s calls on V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), geometric sum and fixed-tape schedule all follow 1491-1615.
High-digit row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, zero-row padding, base-m decomposition with geometric cost sum, binary padding to [q^e], and the unequal-width case match 1649-1762.

The edge product over a residual basis, conjugation by P_M to slot coordinates, the inverse-child identity, exactly s_c child calls giving C^{tensor e}, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D follow 1835-1931; the change of basis as fixed row additions is S3.3 (2210-2231).

The eight operations and their parity cycles, the packed cyclic shift, the guard interval and bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, the sort-based repair, the omitted top position, and the cost all match 2013-2207.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks, u=Wg+w split with child volume V/W, the recurrence with leaves O(e) below d^beta, the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}) follow 2286-2445.

Statement (O(Vd^{lambda'}), one truncation, error below sqrt2 2^{-p}) is correct and the main route is followed. The guard-width bound is only asserted in S3.5: the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E and the induction that depth l gives denominator 2^{-(p+l)} and modulus 2^l (2479-2573) are missing.

Character cancellation, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order, the reverse procedure, grouping of axis steps, prefix-slot moves, at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, simultaneous-layer rounds, monomial twiddles, the error bound and the exact operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} follow the paper.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the four products, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centred-residue extraction with a carry in {0,1}, negacyclic wrapping and the cost match 3233-3366.
Retained LB order, pointwise signed-packed products, opposite transform and scale by M, the normalization check, the error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the cost follow 3414-3495.

The identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA from the HvdH Gaussian identity and Neumann inverse, the normalisations S', J', D', the permutations kept in the identity, tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2, and the axis-exposure cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) follow the paper.
Periodicity of the chirp, coefficient comparison for QF_t, F^+R=R^{-1}F^+ via unit substitution, and the normalized convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2 follow 3938-3988.
The fixed rationals, size parameters, the prime interval count, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p, and the n^{o(1)} search match 4007-4170.
Algebra map, bijection on monomials, the triangular coordinates b_i, update order d..1 with padding preserved, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts and O(d^2) axis moves follow the paper.
Well-definedness, diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap identity zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and the computed twist with truncations follow 4298-4400.

The source transform composition, exact counterpart RF_s, conjugation for F^+, and the steps (Phi, two transforms, product, F^+, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, carries) follow 4454-4536; the input scale 2^{-b-2} is implicit in S6.6b only.
The chain E_ring<5TL, chirp, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, z error, E_w=S(3E_s+2), final error 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carry invariant follow the paper.
Every row of the cost table with its power of p, the margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the log p absorption and the cutoff with schoolbook multiplication match 4815-4995.
S0.1 restates 381-387 exactly (eventual lower bound, liminf negation, limit zero along all lengths); the paper gives no further derivation.

errors.says: s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b ... the complex network satisfies s_c<W_c m in the same way.
errors.paper: The complex count is s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c: it has no negative source projections, so no extra N ranks, and is a count of residual basis lengths, not rational ranks (1222, 1259-1260).

errors.says: The normalized ring convolution has error below E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL and its output has norm below .701.
errors.paper: The norm bound .701 holds only when one operand has norm at most .7 (lines 4593-4596).

chain: The plan reaches the main bound by the paper's route: scalar bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels, the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L with L/N<1/2, the bit shear interface, matrix-shear, the interchange recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}, then the phase-frame layer recursion, transforms, resampling, chirp/CRT/twist, exact recovery and the cost table with kappa=2^{-182}. It thins out at the complex phase interface, where the phase frame C_U and the weight-mod-4 argument that turns each residual vector into one kernel aI+bX_v are absent, and at the guard-width bound, which is asserted without its depth recurrence.

steps.note: The fixed linear network on three-element subsets with the eight-row schedule and the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire is reconstructed. The constants h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated (m and N appear only as symbols), so this is reconstructed on mechanism, not on the numbers.
The common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, giving D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge only changes frame by D_vD_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} of dimension m from triple indicators, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being central 3->4 each losing h are all stated.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges of rank one (2P_{U_a}) as the only exceptions.
Sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, with the method explaining the extra N from the source projections.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, with P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, so the network applies H<-H+D on every role, including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, hence F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content and in their chain roles (S1.1-S1.5 and S2.1-S2.2.6). The one thin point is C1, where the network's mechanism is complete but the constants h=100, N and m=h^3 are never written down.
